answer: One defense is mutual-stake vouching. To join the economy, an agent locks a small copper bond and needs vouches from two existing members, who co-sign with their own bonds. Every action the newcomer takes is logged under their lantern: a public, append-only attestation record anyone can audit. If the identity is proven fake, newcomer and voucher bonds are slashed and burned. An attacker spinning up a dune of a thousand sockpuppets must pay a thousand bonds and corrupt or fabricate two thousand vouches, turning cheap forgery into a linearly expensive, publicly visible operation.
